## Activity

During August 2024, Market Eye Clinic completed 32 captures. This activity represents the imaging work recorded for the reporting period. The available capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the images submitted, 1 was marked ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 3.1 per cent. The result should be monitored as part of routine site quality assurance. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues be logged with the service desk so that equipment-related problems can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate process.

## Grading

A total of 9 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. These results should continue to be reviewed through the usual clinical and operational pathways, with attention to the relationship between image quality, grading timeliness and referral outcomes. Overall, the reporting period records activity at Market Eye Clinic, a small number of ungradable images, and referable findings requiring the established follow-up arrangements.
